s: 張先生夫婦自從結婚以來，不曾吵過架，因為兩人的脾氣都太好了。
Zhāng xiānsheng fūfù zìcóng jiéhūn yǐlái, bùcéng chǎo guò jià, yīnwèi liǎng rén de píqi dōu tài hǎo le.
Since Mr. and Mrs. Zhang got married, they have never had a fight, because both of their tempers are too good.
王先生跟女朋友吵了一架，現在兩個人不說話了。
Wáng xiānsheng gēn nǚpéngyou chǎo le yì jià, xiànzài liǎng ge rén bù shuōhuà le.
Mr. Wang had an argument with his girlfriend; now the two of them are not speaking to each other.
